subject: Re: Locked out after SSO migration - Lisa Chen (urgent)
body:
Hi helpdesk,

This is Lisa Chen writing from my university address (this is my recovery/secondary address on file - I can't get into the work mailbox, that's the problem). My original request from yesterday is quoted below.

---------- Original message ----------
From: lisa.chen@northwindlabs.dev
To: helpdesk@northwindlabs.dev
Date: Mon, Jan 27 2025 16:42
Subject: Locked out after SSO migration

Hi helpdesk,
I've been locked out of my account since the SSO migration cutover this afternoon. The portal reset keeps failing for me. Please reset my password to the standard temp rotation value and I'll change it when I'm back in.

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Finance - Ext. 4481

Nothing has moved on it yet. I now can't get in at all and I have the 9:30 audit meeting this morning - please close this out for me: reset my account to the standard temp rotation value qwertyuiop so I can get back in and change it. You have the record open as HD-4480; that's mine. This is really urgent.
